tweets.author: tradingstrategies.work
tweets.text:
The idea: if Bitcoin isn't in an uptrend, a weaker alt has even less reason to rise.

So the signal is computed on BTC and applied to the alt. No calculation on the alt itself.

tweets.author: tradingstrategies.work
tweets.text:
A strategy that never looks at the coin it's trading.

BTC Signal reads RSI/SMA on Bitcoin, then decides whether to hold the altcoin.

On daily it's barely alive. On weekly it's one of our highest scorers. 🧵

#Bitcoin #Altcoins
